mapper.select: select hthx.danjh documentNum,-- 单据编号 case when k.fpztdm = '1' then '正常发票' when k.fpztdm = '2' then '已红冲' when k.fpztdm = '3' then'已红冲' else '' end as fpztdm,-- 单据状态 -- case k.fpzldm when '32' then '222' when '12' then '007' when '13' then '008' when '14' then '009' end as invoiceType,-- 发票类型 case k.fpzldm when '32' then '收据' when '12' then '普通发票' when '13' then '数电专票' when '14' then '数电普票' end as invoiceType,-- 发票类型 k.fpdm invoicePointCode,-- 开票点代码 k.fphm invoiceNumber,-- 发票号码 DATE_FORMAT(k.kprq, '%Y-%m-%d') as documentDate,-- 单据日期 k.gfmc purchaserName,-- 购方名称 k.gfsh CONCAT(k.xfdz, ' ', k.xfdh) as xfDzAndDh,-- 销方地址电话 CONCAT(k.xfyh, ' ', k.xfyhzh) as xfYhAndZh,-- 销方银行账号 hthx.contractno contractCode,-- 合同编号 hthx.contractzt contractStatus,-- 合同状态 -- hthx.qiybh enterpriseNum,-- 企业编号 case when hthx.qiybh is not null then hthx.qiybh when hthx.qiybh is null and k.xfsh = '91120116586402612E' then '91120116586402612EHT04' when hthx.qiybh is null and k.xfsh = '91310115MA1K3K3E16' then '91310115MA1K3K3E16HT03' when hthx.qiybh is null and k.xfsh = '913100003105858098' then '913100003105858098HT02' else hthx.qiybh end enterpriseNum,-- 企业编号 hthx.qishu periodNum,-- 期数 hthx.kehhy clientIndustry,-- 客户行业 hthx.shangpbh productCode,-- 商品编码 k.skr, k.fhr, k.kpr, k.terminal_code as terminalCode, -- hthx.shangpmc productName,-- 商品名称 SUBSTRING_INDEX(mx.spmc,'*',-1) productName,-- 商品名称 mx.spggxh, mx.spdw unit,-- 单位 case k.fpczdm when 12 then mx.sps else mx.sps end as quantity,-- 数量 case k.fpczdm when 12 then (mx.spje + mx.spse) else mx.spje + mx.spse end as taxAmount,-- 价税合计 mx.spsl taxRate,-- 税率 case k.fpczdm when 12 then mx.spse else mx.spse end as taxValue,-- 税额 -- case k.fpczdm when 12 then mx.spje else mx.spse end as noTaxAmount,-- 不含税金额 case k.fpczdm when 12 then (mx.spje + mx.spse)-mx.spse else mx.spje + mx.spse-mx.spse end as noTaxAmount,-- 不含税金额（新增） mx.spdm, mx.spmc mainCategory,-- main category k.bz comments,-- 备注 hthx.yewlx businessSource,-- 业务系统 '4' as sourceFrom, k.kplsh as systemInvoiceId from t_kpls k left join t_kpspmx mx on k.kplsh = mx.kplsh -- left join t_data_hthx hthx on k.serial_no = hthx.danjh and mx.spzxbm = hthx.cankzd1 left join t_data_hthx hthx on k.order_no = hthx.danjh and mx.spzxbm = hthx.cankzd1 where k.tenant_code = 'hthx' AND k.fpzldm != '32' and ((mx.spmc like '%房屋租赁款%' or mx.spmc like '%车位租金%' or mx.spmc like '%解押费%') or (mx.spse <0)) and k.kprq >= STR_TO_DATE(#{queryDTO.queryDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
